# md2pdf

> Free, no-login, client-side GitHub README to PDF converter and documentation workstation.

md2pdf (developed by LadeStack, founded by Girish Lade) converts public GitHub repositories and local Markdown files into print-ready PDF documents directly in the browser. All processing—fetching, Markdown parsing, HTML sanitization via DOMPurify, vector PDF layout with custom font embedding, and ZIP archiving—runs entirely within the browser sandbox with zero server uploads.

## Core Workflows & Capabilities

- **Single Document Engine**: Paste a GitHub repository URL, upload local Markdown files (`.md`, `.markdown`, `.txt` up to 2 MB), or edit in the browser with live debounced preview.
- **Documentation Book Builder**: Recursively scan GitHub repositories via the Git Trees API, select chapters using an interactive tree with tri-state checkboxes, reorder chapters, generate custom cover pages and hierarchical tables of contents, and print or export.
- **ZIP Export**: Bundle per-chapter PDFs into a single ZIP archive client-side using JSZip, preserving repository folder hierarchies and Unicode filenames.
- **Curated Print Themes**:
  - *Clean*: Neutral, modern sans-serif design for technical documentation.
  - *Business*: Serif display typography tailored for executive and client deliverables.
  - *Academic*: Justified layout and restrained styling for papers and course packs.
  - *Dark*: High-contrast screen preview with automated print legibility optimization.
- **Privacy & Security**: Zero server backend. No accounts, cookies, or remote tracking. All HTML is rigorously sanitized with DOMPurify to strip executable scripts and untrusted objects.
- **Browser-Local Storage**: IndexedDB auto-save (~1s debounce), automatic session restoration, versioned snapshots, full-text search, and JSON backup export/import.
- **Multilingual Support**: Fully localized into 9 languages: English (`/`), Spanish (`/es/`), Japanese (`/ja/`), Korean (`/ko/`), Simplified Chinese (`/zh/`), Russian (`/ru/`), Turkish (`/tr/`), French (`/fr/`), and Brazilian Portuguese (`/pt/`).

## Authoritative Guides & Articles (All 21 Verified Capabilities)

- [7 Practical Use Cases for Turning a README into a PDF](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/readme-to-pdf-use-cases/): Real-world workflows for client handoffs, release archives, course packs, engineering RFCs, and compliance snapshots.
- [GitHub README to PDF Converter](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/github-readme-to-pdf/): Direct repository import, branch resolution, and relative asset rewriting.
- [Multi-File Documentation Book Builder](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/multi-file-markdown-book/): Stitching multi-chapter Markdown handbooks with continuous page numbering.
- [Curated Print Themes](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/readme-pdf-print-themes/): Choosing print stylesheets, typography, and page setups.
- [Browser-First Privacy Architecture](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/browser-only-markdown-to-pdf/): Client-side security model and zero-upload guarantees.
- [Native Browser Printing](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/browser-print-markdown-pdf/): Browser print dialog integration, @media print CSS isolation, and unclipped document printing.
- [Chapter Sequencing and Reordering](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/chapter-sequencing-reordering-pdf/): Chapter queuing, custom sequence ordering, and hierarchical heading depth normalization.
- [GitHub Branch, Tag, and Commit Pinning](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/github-branch-tag-commit-pdf/): Branch switching, release tag targeting, and immutable commit SHA resolution for versioned docs.
- [GitHub Repository Tree Exploration](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/github-repository-markdown-tree/): Recursive Git tree traversal, directory trees, and Markdown discovery.
- [Live Split-Screen Markdown Preview](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/live-markdown-preview-pdf/): Synchronized side-by-side editing, debounced layout proofing, and DOMPurify sanitization.
- [Markdown Code Blocks to PDF](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-code-blocks-to-pdf/): Monospace code styling, language tagging, and print page-break containment.
- [Markdown Paste & Live Editing](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-editor-paste-pdf/): In-browser textarea editing, sample templates, character/word counters, and instant PDF compilation.
- [Markdown File Search & Path Filtering](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-file-search-filter/): In-memory path matching, directory filtering, and rapid file selection.
- [Local Markdown File Upload](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-file-upload-to-pdf/): Client-side file drag-and-drop, multiple file intake, and zero server transmission.
- [Tri-State Folder Selection](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-folder-selection-book/): Cascading directory checkboxes with checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
- [PDF Book Cover-Page Generation](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-pdf-cover-page/): Automated title sheet synthesis with document title, subtitle, author, and timestamp.
- [Relative Images and Links Resolution](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-relative-images-links-pdf/): Computing relative paths, fetching raw assets client-side, and transforming relative links to PDF anchors.
- [Markdown Table of Contents](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-table-of-contents-pdf/): Auto-generating hierarchical TOCs for long documents with clickable PDF bookmarks.
- [GFM Table Rendering and Scaling](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-tables-to-pdf/): GitHub-flavored Markdown tables with column alignments and print border styles.
- [Individual PDF ZIP Export](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/markdown-zip-pdf-export/): Packaging individual chapter PDFs into client-side archives using JSZip.
- [Multilingual Unicode Fonts](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/blog/multilingual-markdown-pdf-fonts/): Font embedding for Latin, Cyrillic, Turkish, and CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) scripts.
- [About md2pdf](https://md2pdf.ladestack.in/about/): Project mission, founder Girish Lade, and LadeStack background.
